osv.comparisonScope: All seven current and previous immutable-generation archives fully CRC-read and JSON-parsed; baselines verified by stored SHA256, byte size and generation. JSON object keys canonicalized recursively; array order and all values retained. Full-content SHA256 compared, not modification timestamps alone.
limitations: Seven independently updated exports, not one synchronized global snapshot.
MAL records counted separately and not library-vulnerability candidates.
Only id and aliases form identity links. related and upstream fields never identify an equal advisory.
Export references are retained, not claimed as independently visited primary sources.

overlapWindow.basis: Each source lastSuccessfulContentCheckAt in the previous successful audit, minus exactly 24 hours; the full archive content comparison is authoritative for additions/corrections outside the timestamp window.
